channels.name: host_command_stream
channels.purpose: Octet stream of marshalled command — TPM_ST + commandSize + commandCode + handles + sessions + parameters.
channels.active_levels: Per platform bus (LPC LVCMOS, SPI LVCMOS, I2C OD)

channels.name: tpm_response_stream
channels.purpose: Octet stream of marshalled response — TPM_ST + responseSize + responseCode + handles + parameters + sessions.

channels.name: tpm_interrupt
channels.purpose: Edge-triggered SERIRQ (LPC) or GPIO (SPI / I2C) indicating dataAvail / commandReady transition.

channels.name: TPM_INT_STATUS
channels.purpose: MMIO register; sticky interrupt cause; write-1-to-clear.

channels.name: TPM_INTF_CAPABILITY
channels.purpose: MMIO register; reports interface version + supported transfer sizes.

channels.name: TPM_STS
channels.purpose: MMIO register; main status (commandReady, tpmGo, dataAvail, Expect, selfTestDone, responseRetry, commandCancel, burstCount).

channels.name: TPM_DATA_FIFO
channels.purpose: MMIO byte-FIFO; carries command/response octet stream.

channels.name: TPM_INTERFACE_ID
channels.purpose: MMIO register; PTP selects FIFO / CRB interface and reports version.

channels.name: TPM_XDATA_FIFO
channels.purpose: MMIO 32-bit alias of DATA_FIFO for bulk transfer.

channels.name: TPM_DID_VID
channels.purpose: MMIO register; Vendor ID (low 16) + Device ID (high 16).

global_signals.name: PLTRST# / TPM_RST#
global_signals.purpose: Platform reset; drives TPM to Init state.

global_signals.name: PP (Physical Presence)
global_signals.purpose: Strap or button tied to platform; sensed via tpmEstablishment bit of TPM_ACCESS.

handshake_pairs.name: LOCALITY_ACQUIRE
handshake_pairs.rule: Write TPM_ACCESS.requestUse=1 → poll TPM_ACCESS.activeLocality for grant.

handshake_pairs.name: COMMAND_READY_HANDSHAKE
handshake_pairs.rule: Write TPM_STS.commandReady=1 → poll TPM_STS.commandReady for 1 (TPM ready).

handshake_pairs.name: FIFO_WRITE_HANDSHAKE
handshake_pairs.rule: Burst-write up to burstCount octets to TPM_DATA_FIFO; re-poll burstCount.

handshake_pairs.name: FIFO_READ_HANDSHAKE
handshake_pairs.rule: Burst-read response from TPM_DATA_FIFO; respect burstCount; dataAvail clears at last octet.

handshake_pairs.name: CANCEL
handshake_pairs.rule: Write TPM_STS.commandCancel=1; some commands respond with TPM_RC_CANCELED.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host CPU drives every transaction. The TPM is a passive responder; it never initiates a bus cycle. SERIRQ / GPIO only indicates dataAvail / commandReady transitions to allow the host to avoid busy-polling.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each command is fully buffered before execution; the TPM does not stream-execute. Response is fully buffered before dataAvail asserts.

power_pins.name: VCC
power_pins.purpose: Main supply 3.3 V (or 1.8 V for low-voltage chips).

power_pins.name: VBAT
power_pins.purpose: Optional battery-backed pin for monotonic clock when host VCC removed (vendor-specific).

ordering_rules.octet_ordering_on_wire: Big-endian (network byte order) for tag, size, commandCode, responseCode.
ordering_rules.structure_ordering: Fields appear in the order declared in Part 2; nested structures are serialized field-by-field.
ordering_rules.sized_buffer: TPM2B_* sized buffer: 2-byte size prefix (UINT16) + N octets data.
